name: htag-docs
description: The htag-docs MCP server is HtAG’s public documentation and discovery layer for developers building against the HtAG API ecosystem. It lets Claude inspect which MCP servers HtAG exposes, list the tools available on each server, browse public REST endpoints, retrieve full OpenAPI operation details, and discover callable HtAG micro-agents. It is designed for developer enablement: understanding what data and capabilities exist, selecting the right endpoint or MCP tool, generating accurate integration guidance, and helping teams move from idea to working implementation without manually reading the whole API catalogue.

_published_faq.name: How do I add htag-docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add htag-docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.htagai.com/mcp/v1/servers/htag-docs/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is htag-docs MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, htag-docs scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is htag-docs's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, htag-docs scores 62/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 5 of 5 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the htag-docs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: htag-docs provides these MCP tools: get_api_endpoint, list_api_endpoints, list_mcp_servers, list_mcp_tools, and list_micro_agents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to htag-docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to htag-docs in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
htag-docs does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can htag-docs improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: list_api_endpoints is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 51/100. 0 of 2 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
htag-docs is developed by HtAG Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
